description.value: North Road Sushi & Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant in the Lougheed Town Centre area of Burnaby, offering a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, noodles, katsu, and donburi. The restaurant is noted by customers for generous portions, fresh fish, and good value. Both dine-in and online pickup or delivery orders are available through their Foodly partnership.
